records.statement: The source reports a finite-duration concurrent fabric burn; the narrative says it ended when airflow was stopped. It is not an intrinsic extinction-time measurement.
missing: Original raw-file identity and sensor calibration linkage
issues: PSI-98 S1 lists thickness 0.37 cm whereas Table I states 0.37 mm; no silent conversion or correction.
PSI-98 S1 labels length 40.6 and width 94 cm, opposite the paper's width/length assignment.
PDF page 8 lists ignition power 165 W whereas Table I lists 182 W; retain both locators for reconciliation.
Oxygen is a derived changing range, not a calibrated BASS vol% measurement.
The compared small-width tests also differ in oxygen and edge entrainment; no one-variable scale/airflow inference.

raw.oxygenBasis: Table I footnote i; derived, ISS-referenced

records.statement: The opposed-flow test used fuel remaining after the concurrent test; it is not an independent repeat on a pristine 94 cm sample.
missing: Original raw-file identity and sensor calibration linkage
issues: PSI-98 S2 still lists the full 94 cm dimension; the paper gives approximately 10 cm remaining for sample 1-2.
Previous burn history and declining oxygen confound a direct concurrent-versus-opposed causal comparison.
Approximate oxygen and length must retain approximation markers.
PSI thickness-unit and width/length discrepancies also affect S2.

records.statement: The silicone results describe a small flame that extinguished after ignition power ended, without sustained spread; this is not a zero-second measured burn or a general nonflammability verdict.
missing: Original raw-file identity and sensor calibration linkage
issues: Do not coerce Insignificant, ~0 or n/a into exact numeric zeros.
The narrative discusses several silicone samples collectively; the individual outcome remains the Table I row.
PSI-98 is Saffire-I, not a dataset identity for this Saffire-II sample.
Potential silica deposition and cracking are unresolved mechanisms, not measured causes.

psiDiscovery.result: PSI-98 Version 4, DOI 10.60555/0t15-1z43, CC0-1.0 inspected. S1/S2 rows provide cross-checks but contain thickness-unit and length/width conflicts with the paper. Project dates/platform also conflict with the flight narrative. No rows admitted or automatically normalized.
